description: Turns Zero-Shot Annotation output (or a Smart Labeler annotations.json) into a ready-to-train YOLO dataset: images and labels split into train/val, plus data.yaml. Wire its dataset output to Model Training's dataset input and set Model Training's data file to data.yaml.

inputs.name: annotations
inputs.description: Zero-Shot Annotation's annotations output, or any Smart Labeler-format annotations.json (Smart Labeler, Model Inference).

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The image folder the annotations were made on: the same folder wired into Zero-Shot Annotation's images input. Images are copied into the dataset.

outputs.name: dataset
outputs.description: The YOLO dataset folder: data.yaml, classes.txt, images/{train,val}, labels/{train,val}.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Classes, images per split, labels per class, and anything dropped (low score, unknown class, unmatched image).

task.description: 'detect' writes boxes. 'segment' writes polygons from the zero-shot masks (needs masks in its output; a box-only annotation becomes a rectangle). Match Model Training's task.

val_split.description: Fraction of images held out for validation (0–1). At 0, validation reuses the training images.

seed.description: Random seed for the train/val split, so the same inputs always split the same way.

min_score.description: Drop annotations whose confidence is below this (0–1). 0 keeps everything the zero-shot step kept.

classes.description: Optional comma-separated class names, in the index order the model should use (e.g. 'spot, rust'). Labels not listed are dropped. Empty uses every label found, sorted alphabetically.

drop_empty.description: Leave out images with no annotations. Off by default: they're kept as background images, which helps the model learn what isn't an object.

exec_queue.description: Scheduler queue. This is a CPU-only job, so it defaults to a CPU queue (overrides the run-level queue).

tapis_job.name: zero-shot-to-yolo
tapis_job.description: Convert annotations to a YOLO dataset

appArgs.name: tool
appArgs.description: The shared wf-utils container runs several small tools; this picks which one (jobs/wf_utils/).
